panels.title: Total (USD/mo)
panels.description: List-price estimate of monthly DO spend across the selected cluster(s). Not the DO invoice.

targets.expr:
(sum ((
  label_replace(count by (cluster) (kube_node_info{cluster=~"$cluster"}) * on(cluster) group_left() max by (cluster) (dantofa_node_hourly_price_usd) * 730, "c", "compute", "", "")
  or label_replace(sum by (cluster) (kube_persistentvolume_capacity_bytes{cluster=~"$cluster"}) / 1073741824 * on(cluster) group_left() max by (cluster) (dantofa_block_storage_gib_hourly_usd) * 730, "c", "storage", "", "")
  or label_replace(count by (cluster) (kube_service_spec_type{cluster=~"$cluster", type="LoadBalancer"}) * on(cluster) group_left() max by (cluster) (dantofa_lb_hourly_price_usd) * 730, "c", "lb", "", "")
  or label_replace(clamp_min(sum by (cluster) (increase(node_network_transmit_bytes_total{cluster=~"$cluster", device="eth0"}[30d])) / 1073741824 - count by (cluster) (kube_node_info{cluster=~"$cluster"}) * on(cluster) group_left() max by (cluster) (dantofa_node_transfer_gib), 0) * 0.01, "c", "traffic", "", "")
))) or vector(0)

panels.title: Compute (USD/mo)
panels.description: Node count x worker-size hourly price (DO Sizes API), summed over selected clusters.

targets.expr: (sum (count by (cluster) (kube_node_info{cluster=~"$cluster"}) * on(cluster) group_left() max by (cluster) (dantofa_node_hourly_price_usd) * 730)) or vector(0)

panels.title: Storage (USD/mo)
panels.description: Provisioned PersistentVolume bytes x DO block-storage rate.

targets.expr: (sum (sum by (cluster) (kube_persistentvolume_capacity_bytes{cluster=~"$cluster"}) / 1073741824 * on(cluster) group_left() max by (cluster) (dantofa_block_storage_gib_hourly_usd) * 730)) or vector(0)

panels.title: LoadBalancers (USD/mo)
panels.description: type=LoadBalancer Service count x DOKS LB price.

targets.expr: (sum (count by (cluster) (kube_service_spec_type{cluster=~"$cluster", type="LoadBalancer"}) * on(cluster) group_left() max by (cluster) (dantofa_lb_hourly_price_usd) * 730)) or vector(0)

panels.title: Traffic overage (USD/mo, est.)
panels.description: Upper-bound estimate: eth0 egress over 30d beyond the pooled per-node allowance, at $0.01/GiB.

targets.expr: (sum (clamp_min(sum by (cluster) (increase(node_network_transmit_bytes_total{cluster=~"$cluster", device="eth0"}[30d])) / 1073741824 - count by (cluster) (kube_node_info{cluster=~"$cluster"}) * on(cluster) group_left() max by (cluster) (dantofa_node_transfer_gib), 0) * 0.01)) or vector(0)

panels.title: Monthly cost by cluster (USD, estimated)
panels.description: Per-cluster total, sortable — the cross-cluster single pane.

targets.expr:
sum by (cluster) ((
  label_replace(count by (cluster) (kube_node_info{cluster=~"$cluster"}) * on(cluster) group_left() max by (cluster) (dantofa_node_hourly_price_usd) * 730, "c", "compute", "", "")
  or label_replace(sum by (cluster) (kube_persistentvolume_capacity_bytes{cluster=~"$cluster"}) / 1073741824 * on(cluster) group_left() max by (cluster) (dantofa_block_storage_gib_hourly_usd) * 730, "c", "storage", "", "")
  or label_replace(count by (cluster) (kube_service_spec_type{cluster=~"$cluster", type="LoadBalancer"}) * on(cluster) group_left() max by (cluster) (dantofa_lb_hourly_price_usd) * 730, "c", "lb", "", "")
  or label_replace(clamp_min(sum by (cluster) (increase(node_network_transmit_bytes_total{cluster=~"$cluster", device="eth0"}[30d])) / 1073741824 - count by (cluster) (kube_node_info{cluster=~"$cluster"}) * on(cluster) group_left() max by (cluster) (dantofa_node_transfer_gib), 0) * 0.01, "c", "traffic", "", "")
))

panels.title: Monthly cost by component (USD/mo)
panels.description: Compute, storage and LoadBalancer monthly cost over time (summed over selected clusters), stacked.

targets.expr: sum (count by (cluster) (kube_node_info{cluster=~"$cluster"}) * on(cluster) group_left() max by (cluster) (dantofa_node_hourly_price_usd) * 730)
sum (sum by (cluster) (kube_persistentvolume_capacity_bytes{cluster=~"$cluster"}) / 1073741824 * on(cluster) group_left() max by (cluster) (dantofa_block_storage_gib_hourly_usd) * 730)
sum (count by (cluster) (kube_service_spec_type{cluster=~"$cluster", type="LoadBalancer"}) * on(cluster) group_left() max by (cluster) (dantofa_lb_hourly_price_usd) * 730)
